title: A Protocol for the Drop
author: B. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
